intelligence.essence: A post is more default — NOT auto-formatted. Straight up: here you're posting, and it has the social part, the social share part. If you wanted unformatted, you would just post. A post CAN be beautifully formatted if chosen, or one block — but the default is straight up, not auto-formatted. The taxonomy: smart note = auto-formatted, public, social part, no name, cannot unformat · Naya note = auto-formatted (can unformat in Settings), private, no social part, may carry name · post = not auto-formatted by default, straight up, social share part. Images work on all of them.
